title: A new version of differential flow heat capacity calorimeter; tests of heat loss corrections and heat capacities of aqueous NaCl from T = 300 K to T = 623 K
authors: Lubomir Hnedkovsky, Vladimir Hynek, Vladimir Majer, Robert H. Wood
experimental_method: New differential isoperibol flow heat-capacity calorimeter (to 700 K, 35 MPa): power for a constant temperature rise with sample and with water, heat-loss factor f from single-pump flow-rate calibrations; cp,s/cp,w of NaCl(aq) 0.015 to 6 mol/kg, 303 to 623 K, 0.1 to 30.6 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: Per-point deltaCp,phi by error propagation (power, molality, f); molality uncertainty below 0.03 per cent.
quality_remarks: Three probable misprints flagged and kept as printed: row 122 molality 0.4000 (values belong to 0.2002), rows 300-301 T = 632.20 K (implied water cp equal to the 623.20 K rows), row 68 deltaCp,phi 0.00 with an outlying Cp,phi. Literature column (Archer fit) deviates strongly at 623 K. Internal check: implied water cp from m, cp ratio and Cp,phi constant within every T/p group apart from row 122. Temperature scale not stated.
